method.cluster_rule: Warmup CAM principal-component-1 within-class stable sorting into balanced quantile bins; assignments fixed; current CAM patient projections re-aggregated differentiably each epoch.
method.prototype_leave_one_out: Per query, subtract only the query's projected feature and count from its own support cluster; test queries are never support members.
method.evidence: Per-class prompt softmax of direct patient-text cosine plus same-vs-opposite projected prototype cosine difference.
method.residual: gamma=0.5*tanh(alpha), initial gamma=0.1; signed evidence tanh; apply +/- delta/2 to base log probabilities then log_softmax.
